records.key: Choose a valid image series.
records.source: Choose a valid image series.
records.translation: 请选择有效的图像序列。

records.key: Choose a valid time, Z plane and image channel.
records.source: Choose a valid time, Z plane and image channel.
records.translation: 请选择有效的时间点、Z 平面和图像通道。

records.key: Choose the stored image series.
records.source: Choose the stored image series.
records.translation: 请选择已存储的图像序列。

records.key: Image axes
records.source: Image axes
records.translation: 图像轴

records.key: Image plane
records.source: Image plane
records.translation: 图像平面

records.key: Independent-file import identities collide; no images can be imported.
records.source: Independent-file import identities collide; no images can be imported.
records.translation: 独立文件的导入标识冲突；无法导入任何图像。

records.key: Open image
records.source: Open image
records.translation: 打开图像

records.key: Review the stored spatial, time and channel axes before opening this image.
records.source: Review the stored spatial, time and channel axes before opening this image.
records.translation: 打开此图像前，请检查已存储的空间轴、时间轴和通道轴。

records.key: Review this source and image plane again before reusing its mask destination.
records.source: Review this source and image plane again before reusing its mask destination.
records.translation: 再次使用其掩膜保存目标前，请重新检查此来源和图像平面。

records.key: Series {index}: {shape}
records.source: Series {index}: {shape}
records.translation: 序列 {index}：{shape}

records.key: Stored shape: {shape}. Choose the recorded axis order; no projection is applied.
records.source: Stored shape: {shape}. Choose the recorded axis order; no projection is applied.
records.translation: 存储形状：{shape}。请选择记录的轴顺序；不会应用投影。

records.key: The image source is not a regular file.
records.source: The image source is not a regular file.
records.translation: 图像来源不是常规文件。

records.key: The reader returned an invalid or changed image plane.
records.source: The reader returned an invalid or changed image plane.
records.translation: 读取器返回了无效或已发生变化的图像平面。

records.key: The selected image plane exceeds the 256 MiB editor limit.
records.source: The selected image plane exceeds the 256 MiB editor limit.
records.translation: 所选图像平面超过编辑器的 256 MiB 限制。

records.key: The selected native image exceeds the 256 MiB editor limit. Use Import.
records.source: The selected native image exceeds the 256 MiB editor limit. Use Import.
records.translation: 所选原生格式图像超过编辑器的 256 MiB 限制。请使用“导入”。

records.key: The source changed after its image layout was reviewed. Open it again.
records.source: The source changed after its image layout was reviewed. Open it again.
records.translation: 检查图像布局后，来源发生了变化。请重新打开。

records.key: The source changed while its image metadata was read. Open it again.
records.source: The source changed while its image metadata was read. Open it again.
records.translation: 读取图像元数据时，来源发生了变化。请重新打开。

records.key: This container has no bounded image series. Use Import.
records.source: This container has no bounded image series. Use Import.
records.translation: 此容器中没有大小有界的图像序列。请使用“导入”。

records.key: This container has too many series to review safely. Use Import.
records.source: This container has too many series to review safely. Use Import.
records.translation: 此容器中的序列过多，无法安全检查。请使用“导入”。

records.key: This container needs an unsupported spatial layout. Use Import.
records.source: This container needs an unsupported spatial layout. Use Import.
records.translation: 此容器需要不受支持的空间布局。请使用“导入”。

records.key: This file has no shared image reader. Use Import to inspect it.
records.source: This file has no shared image reader. Use Import to inspect it.
records.translation: 此文件没有可用的共享图像读取器。请使用“导入”进行检查。

records.key: This image has too many frames to review safely. Use Import.
records.source: This image has too many frames to review safely. Use Import.
records.translation: 此图像的帧数过多，无法安全检查。请使用“导入”。

records.key: This reader needs the selected series decoded together; its numeric data must fit within 256 MiB. Use Import for larger series.
records.source: This reader needs the selected series decoded together; its numeric data must fit within 256 MiB. Use Import for larger series.
records.translation: 此读取器需要一次性解码所选的整个序列；解码后的数值数据必须能容纳在 256 MiB 内。更大的序列请使用“导入”。

records.key: {axis} (0-based)
records.source: {axis} (0-based)
records.translation: {axis}（从 0 开始）
